skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: Sunburn SS.SP
skins.content: MARTHE [Coral Coast] Sunburn Series Swimming Suit Type SP. Special Rhine Lab Collaboration Type. To meet Rhine Lab's specifications, this outfit is both comfortable and possesses heat-resistant properties.
skins.usage: A special beach outfit made for Ifrit.

skins.name: Children's Party
skins.content: Rhodes Kitchen Collection/Children's Party. Designed by Silence. Made with special materials from Rhine Lab, it offers a completely unnecessary amount of protection.
skins.quote: It'd be best not to let her into the kitchen.

skins.name: Relaxing Trip
skins.content: Brand Collaborative Series/Relaxing Trip. Mark monsters, fortresses, and treasures on the map. Bring along your beloved dolls, a warm drink, and a cheerful mood. Come on, this is what it means to start a trip.
skins.quote: According to Ifrit, 'There ain't a single problem I can't crush.' Even if it's a string of numbers that makes no sense, or a totally boring travel plan—'The only difficulty setting is 'Easy'? I could clear it easily even on the highest one!'
